tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Ground: the wall behind everything; it carries the sun's tint for the stop. Never a control face.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Ground: the face of every raised thing (pane, control, float). Always paired with `shadow-bevel` and its level's shadow (`shadow-control`, or the twin `shadow-pane` / `shadow-float`).

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Ground: recessed wells (tracks, digit boxes) and disabled faces. Pair with `shadow-well`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Ground: hairlines that divide rows inside a pane, and the Timer ring track. Decorative only; never the sole cue for state.

tokens.name: line-bright
tokens.usage: Ground: the stronger hairline for dividers that sit on `bg`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text: primary copy, names, readings, the label and state word on an on control. Reads on `bg`, `panel` and `panel-2`, `sunlit`, `wash-heat` over `panel`, `wash-cool` over `panel`, `wash-ok` over `panel`, `wash-warn` over `panel` and `wash-bad` over `panel`. Fixed across the five day stops.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Text: secondary copy, units, an off control's state word, stale readings. Reads on `bg`, `panel` and `panel-2`, `wash-heat` over `panel` and `wash-cool` over `panel`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Text: microlabels and disabled labels; the floor for any copy. Reads on `bg`, `panel` and `panel-2`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Text: the climate target figure, links and the selected value in a ladder. Also the Segmented slab fill and the Slider fill. Reads on `bg`, `panel` and `panel-2`.

tokens.name: accent-dim
tokens.usage: Text: a pending target (sent, not yet confirmed). Reads on `bg`, `panel` and `panel-2`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text: labels on an `accent` fill (the selected Segmented slab). Reads on `accent`.

tokens.name: sunlit
tokens.usage: Fill: the face of a control that is on (a light, a scene, the AC power). It is the sun catching the face, in that hour's colour; at night it is a dim ember. Only for on; never for selection (that is `accent`) and never decoration.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Mark: control borders that carry state: the Switch track and thumb rim, the Slider rungs, the off pip ring. Holds 3:1 on `bg`, `panel`, `panel-2` and `sunlit`.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: Mark: the Sheet grabber and other drag handles; quieter than `edge`, still plain at arm's length. Holds 3:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Mark: the keyboard focus ring, 3px solid with a 3px gap. Holds 3:1 on `bg`, `panel`, `panel-2` and `sunlit`.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Text: healthy status words and the ok status dot. Reads on `bg`, `panel` and `panel-2` and `wash-ok` over `panel`.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Text: warnings and "Unavailable". Reads on `bg`, `panel` and `panel-2` and `wash-warn` over `panel`.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Text: errors ("Couldn't set. Tap to retry.") and the bad status dot. Reads on `bg`, `panel` and `panel-2` and `wash-bad` over `panel`.

tokens.name: stale
tokens.usage: Text: the Stale tag and "Updated 14 min ago" lines. Reads on `bg`, `panel` and `panel-2`. An alias of `ink-faint` so stale never looks like an error.

tokens.name: meter
tokens.usage: Mark: Vitals meter fill, sparkline stroke, Timer ring arc (phase 2). Holds 3:1 on `panel`, `panel-2` and `line`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Wash: dims the room behind a Dialog or the takeover Alert (phase 2). Nothing reads on the scrim itself; text sits on the float above it.

tokens.name: wash-heat
tokens.usage: Wash: over a pane while the AC is heating. The wash is a static tint, never pulsing; on a ClimateTile the working glow in the same colour breathes while the unit runs (glow means live state only).

tokens.name: wash-cool
tokens.usage: Wash: over a pane while the AC is cooling or drying.

tokens.name: wash-ok
tokens.usage: Wash: behind a resolved Alert or a healthy server line (phase 2).

tokens.name: wash-warn
tokens.usage: Wash: behind a warning Alert or Toast (phase 2).

tokens.name: wash-bad
tokens.usage: Wash: behind an error Alert, the takeover and a failed Toast (phase 2).

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: A live reading the room reports: current temperature, outside temperature. Never rolls.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A value the person sets: the climate target in its odometer reel, in `accent`.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Measurements in small type: the server line, units, timer remainders.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Chip labels, rows, sheet copy. Weight 600 so Quicksand holds at 3 m.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Microlabels and state words (ON, OFF, UNAVAILABLE). Set in uppercase in CSS; never below 15px.

spacing.note: 4px base. Touch sizes are spacing tokens too.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Pip to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a control, between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between chips in a grid; between a microlabel and its figure.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding; gap between rows in a pane.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Pane padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between panes.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen gutter at 1180 px.

tokens.name: hit
tokens.usage: The touch size of every control: height of Button, Chip, Stepper keys, Segmented; the hit area of an icon button.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: The floor for a secondary target (a dismiss or an expand in a tight corner). Never below.

radius.note: Soft and solid. Pills only for things that toggle.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Wells: PIN digit boxes, the Slider track.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, Stepper keys, the Segmented track and slab.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panes and floats.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, the Switch, pips and status dots.

shadow.note: One light: the real sun. Every dark cast falls along the stop's light vector. Panes and floats carry the kiosk twin: a light cast on the exact opposite side, toward the sun. Controls keep one cast. Every raised face carries `shadow-bevel` on its sun side. Values are computed from sunroom-light.ts per stop.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Rest shadow of every raised control (Button, Chip, Switch thumb, Stepper keys): one soft cast along the stop's light vector plus a 1px contact. Painted on the control's ::before layer so press can fade it.

tokens.name: shadow-contact
tokens.usage: Pressed shadow: the control sits down on the sill, only the 1px contact stays. Painted on the ::after layer; it fades in as shadow-control fades out.

tokens.name: shadow-pane
tokens.usage: Panes (Surface level "pane"): tiles, the climate tile, grouped controls. The kiosk twin: a dark cast along the stop's light vector and a light cast on the exact opposite (sun) side, plus a 1px crease where the pane meets the sill. Always with `shadow-bevel`.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating layers (Sheet, Dialog, Toast): the same twin as a pane at 1.5x the length (owner, 2026-11-04), so they sit higher; the scrim still sets dialogs apart. Never on a resting element.

tokens.name: shadow-bevel
tokens.usage: The sun-side rim: a 1px highlight on the edge that faces the sun and a faint shade on the far edge. On every raised face (pane, control, float); on panes it holds the edge against the twin's sun-side halo.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Recessed grounds: Segmented track, Slider track, Switch track, PIN digit boxes. The light falls into the well from the sun side.
